name: Warded Core
description: Fold the ward tight round the core of the soul so that a probing push finds no seam.

name: Slack Turn
description: Give a little ground with the ward so that a sharp blow spends itself on the slack.

name: Pulse Read
description: Read the pulse of a hostile soul through the contact of its blows and judge its strength.

name: Core Rest
description: Rest the soul on its warded core and let the hurts of a hard contest close.

name: Layer Swap
description: Swap a battered outer layer of the ward for a fresh inner one between two blows.

name: Null Catch
description: Hollow out the point of impact so that a soul blow strikes only empty ward.

name: Ward Hold
description: Hold the full ward against a determined assault and let its strength spread out evenly.

name: Rebound Seal
description: Catch a soul assault on the ward and press a share of it back to dull the sender.

name: Angle Guard
description: Meet a soul blow with the ward set at a slant so that its weight runs off to the side.

name: Slide Brace
description: Brace the ward on the side of the strike and let the rest of the soul stay loose.

name: Weight Gauge
description: Gauge the weight of a coming soul blow by the pressure on the front of the ward.

name: Bruise Ease
description: Ease the soul bruise left by a glancing blow with a slow warm pulse of will.

name: Wide Slip
description: Slip the ward wide at the last instant so that a heavy lash cuts only air.

name: Lash Catch
description: Catch a soul lash in a fold of the ward and hold it until its force dies.

name: Taint Clear
description: Clear the foul residue that a turned blow leaves on the ward of an ally or the self.

name: Wide Throw
description: Throw a blow wide of the mind and let it rattle the sender's own focus as it goes.

name: Heavy Glance
description: Turn the whole ward to glance away the weight of a crushing soul strike held for many breaths.

name: Spirit Wrap
description: Wrap the whole spirit in a close ward that covers heart and thought alike.

name: Spread Skin
description: Spread the ward thin and wide so that a scattered soul blast loses its bite.

name: Edge Survey
description: Run attention round the edge of the ward to find where a spread attack is thinnest.

name: Spirit Salve
description: Spread a calm salve of will over a spirit scorched by a wide soul blast.

name: Thickening Ward
description: Draw the ward in from its edges so that it grows thick where the blast is worst.

name: Burst Dull
description: Dull the front of a soul burst with a flat counter-pulse before it reaches the ward.

name: Whole Cover
description: Cover the user and nearby allies in one wide ward that bears the full soul blast together.

name: Pulse Counter
description: Meet the pulse of a soul blast with its exact opposite so that both cancel at the ward.

name: Twin Ward
description: Raise two wards side by side so that each covers the weak line of the other.

name: Paired Turn
description: Turn a blow from the first ward onto the second so that it is guided out and away.

name: Dual Hearing
description: Read a hostile soul through both wards at once and judge where it favours its blows.

name: Pairing Salve
description: Let the whole ward mend the cracked one by borrowing calm from its twin.

name: Second Catch
description: Catch with the second ward what the first has let through at the instant it breaks.

name: Pivot Ward
description: Swing the twin wards on a shared hinge so that they open and close against each blow.

name: Tandem Lend
description: Lend the second ward to an ally for a few breaths so that they too stand doubled.

name: Twin Rebuke
description: Return a soul blow through the twin wards in one matched stroke aimed at the sender.

name: Tandem Fold
description: Fold the twin wards round an ally as well as the self and keep both steady.

name: Azure Veil
description: Draw a high clear veil about the soul that lets in the light but not a hostile touch.

name: Hawk Drop
description: Drop the veil sharply as an attack arrives so that the blow overshoots the mind.

name: Lofty Sense
description: Lift the senses high above the ward to watch a hostile soul gather its force from afar.

name: Clear Sky
description: Let the clouded mind clear like a bright morning sky after a long soul contest.

name: Veil Stoop
description: Stoop the veil on a striking soul force and brush it into the open air.

name: Wide Wing
description: Spread the veil like two wings across allies at the user's side.

name: Stooping Eye
description: Pick out the exact soul that aims at the user and set the veil thick before it strikes.

name: Lofty Cover
description: Gather the veil over several breaths and bring it down as one great cover on the whole group.

name: Mantle Weave
description: Weave two soul tracks into a close mantle that wraps the mind and the body.

name: Track Switch
description: Pass a blow from one track of the mantle to the other and let it spend itself.

name: Thread Feel
description: Feel along both threads of the mantle for tension that shows a hostile soul pulling.

name: Thread Darn
description: Darn a torn thread of the mantle with slow even stitches of attention.

name: Double Weft
description: Thicken the mantle with a second weft so that a heavy blow tears neither track.

name: Flesh Mantle
description: Carry the mantle across to the body so that a blow aimed at the flesh is softened too.

name: Mantle Cleanse
description: Shake out the mantle and cast off any hostile soul residue clinging to its threads.

name: Royal Mantle
description: Draw the full mantle about mind and body and bear a long contest without strain.

name: Mantle Cast
description: Spin the mantle out over an ally and lend it the weave of both tracks.

name: Wind Guard
description: Hold the guard loose as a sail so that a gust of will passes through it.

name: Gust Lean
description: Lean the guard with the push of a hostile will so that it bends and does not break.

name: Weathercock Turn
description: Turn the senses like a vane to find the quarter from which the hostile will blows.

name: Calm After
description: Let the soul go still as air after a gust and the strain of the push drains off.

name: Sail Spill
description: Spill the weight of a heavy blow from the guard as a sail spills a hard wind.

name: Sworn Lean
description: Swear the guard to bend and hold and keep that oath through a long push.

name: Yielding Palm
description: Open the guard wide and let the hostile force blow clean through without a hold.

name: Whirl Away
description: Whirl the guard so that a heavy blow is spun off and the sender is thrown off stride.

name: Heading Anchor
description: Fix the mind on a single bearing and refuse every pull away from it.

name: Bearing Turn
description: Keep to the line of the bearing as a hostile will tries to turn the mind aside.

name: Needle Check
description: Check the needle of the mind for any drift from the chosen bearing.

name: True Again
description: Bring a mind knocked off its bearing back to true with a few steady breaths.

name: Rigid Bearing
description: Hold the line so steadily that a stronger will finds no purchase on the mind.

name: Course Correct
description: Correct a mind steered wrong by a forced thought and clear the thought away.

name: Pull Reversal
description: Turn a hostile pull into a pull toward the user's own bearing aimed at the sender.

name: Unmoved Course
description: Hold a course so firmly that every force trying to turn the mind comes to nothing.

name: Shared Bearing
description: Share the bearing with nearby allies so that all hold the same line together.

name: Stormsworn Vow
description: Swear aloud within the mind to hold and let the oath stand as the guard.

name: Storm Lean
description: Lean into the storm of will and let it pass over the sworn mind.

name: Breeze Count
description: Count the shifts of the breeze of will to find when the next strong push comes.

name: Oath Rest
description: Rest on the oath after the storm and let the aching mind grow level.

name: Vow Quiet
description: Hold the sworn stillness through a rising gale of hostile will.

name: Oath Echo
description: Speak the oath again in the mind of an ally so that they stand as firmly as the user.

name: Unbowed Soul
description: Stand unbowed against the full strength of a gust of will and take no hurt from it.

name: Gust Breaker
description: Break the shape of a gust of will with one sworn word so that it scatters.
